text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Those side dishes you gave us the other 
day— 
every one was delicious, Phalaenopsis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right, Brian? 
The meatballs especially—you couldn't 
stop your chopsticks either, could you?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That is most gratifying. Mother, who sent 
the ingredients, will be pleased as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
From Auntie? Was it really all right 
for us to eat that much of it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I should say it was her very wish. 
She sent such a heap, telling me 
to share it with the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is that so…… 
Hehe, I can never thank Auntie enough 
for her thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, on the vegetables she had even 
written a note—'For Brian-chan.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian, your aunt was worried about you, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, it's quite all right. I knew you 
would say that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
So—I took the first move. 
You ate the meatballs, did you not, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Carrots, lotus root, onions... 
Hehe, I had them packed in generously.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—...Tch. 
Both mother and daughter, such meddlers...
